nodes.name: ERPNext Request
nodes.notes: Paste this node's PRODUCTION URL into ilL-QBO-Settings → n8n QuickBooks Proxy URL. Keep Options → Raw Body ON (the signature covers the exact bytes).

nodes.name: Verify & Build Request
nodes.notes: Checks ERPNext's HMAC signature and timestamp, and only allows QuickBooks paths ERPNext uses. Set QBO_REALM_ID (QuickBooks Company ID) as an n8n Variable.

nodes.name: QuickBooks GET
nodes.notes: Select the QuickBooks OAuth2 credential (same one the payment workflow uses).

nodes.name: QuickBooks POST
nodes.notes: Select the same QuickBooks OAuth2 credential. Creates carry an Intuit requestid, so a retry can't duplicate a record.
